privileged_info_for_vlm: The middle zinc finger (Finger 2) is coordinated by Zinc ion 202. The four coordinating residues in PDB 1AAY are CYS 137, CYS 140, HIS 153, and HIS 157. The average distance between the Zinc and the coordinating atoms is approximately 2.0-2.1 Angstroms. Arg46 in the task description refers to the residue labeled ARG 149 in the PDB file; it hydrogen-bonds specifically with a Guanine (G) base in the major groove. The report must be at /home/ga/PyMOL_Data/zif268_report.txt and the image at /home/ga/PyMOL_Data/images/zif268_finger2.png.
